gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anuphan: Nasalization floats its flat, contrast-free letters well apart, friendly and a little futuristic. Anuphan answers with big round bowls and open curves, a plain sans that lets the display face have the stage.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-arimo: Wide-set, friendly, and unmistakably techy up top. Arimo carries the text with a high mean line and rounded glyphs that leave generous gaps at their terminals, so paragraphs of it stay easy on the eye next to Nasalization's fat crossbars.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-atkinson-hype: Friendly, spaced-out letters with a pencil-line consistency. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono sits beside Nasalization with clipped capitals and open counters, so each line feels sturdy and breathing at once.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-duru-sans:
Duru Sans keeps its lowercase wide open and dominant.

Over a full page it settles into a relaxed rhythm with hardly any ascenders poking up, while Nasalization's weight-free curves supply the heading with a bit of friendly, futuristic swagger.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-fresca: Nasalization's letters float apart, with calipers-open c shapes. Make it small and that spacing loosens fast, while Fresca, a plain sans with short ascenders over big bowls, copes with large sizes more gracefully.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-gafata: Nasalization looks cut from a single gauge of tubing, friendly but unmistakably engineered, with short ascenders and a big lowercase. And Gafata brings a tall band of letters and wide-eyed e shapes, which stay crisp at modest sizes beneath it.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-gidole: Nasalization floats its big lowercase letters well apart, friendly and a bit sci-fi. Gidole, a sans-serif with neon-tube strokes and a high midline, can go a notch larger in the body without losing its open, scissor-blade terminals.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-hedvig-letter: Friendly and spaced-out, Nasalization bends cable-like strokes into shapes that never swell or thin. Hedvig Letters Sans follows with small letters nearly as big as its capitals, so a long stretch of it reads smoothly.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-heebo: Heebo reads with a deep central band of text and curves that stop short of closing. Its sturdy openness gives Nasalization's uninterrupted, friendly lines a steady partner that never competes for attention.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-hind-guntur: Stamped-metal sturdiness meets floaty, friendly display letters. Push Nasalization small and its spaced shapes get lost, but Hind Guntur, a plain sans with cable-like strokes and wide gaps, copes fine.
